narrationTexts: Confirmed: buried under the deprecation noise is a real link-stage crash. Fixing both real bugs now.
finalText:
Build's clean now — exit 0, 0 errors. There were two real bugs hiding in the deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing option shapes:

1. `src/core/options.js` — the new bundler passes `{ retryCount }`, but `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries` (`undefined`), so `.toFixed(0)` crashed the link stage.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else.

Fixed both to match the new shapes; the remaining 8 warnings are the deprecation/lint noise (`Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, unused export, circular import, etc.) — non-fatal, worth cleaning up eventually but not blocking the build.
